content.title: Who is in Elite 8? March Madness NCAA Tournament team breakdown
content.text: Updated March 28, 2026, 8:36 a.m. MTWho is in the Elite Eight?We will be down to just eight teams remaining in the 2026 NCAA Tournament after the Sweet 16 games on Thursday, March 26, and Friday, March 27.Who are the teams that are just one win away from the Final Four?Take a quick look at the eight teams remaining in March Madness, as they advance to the Elite Eight.The Big Ten had six teams in March Madness entering the Sweet 16, while the SEC had four. The Big 12 had three teams left. The Big East had two. The ACC had one.March Madness Elite 8 picks: Iowa vs Illinois | Purdue vs Arizona | Tennessee vs Michigan | UConn vs Duke | The Republic's predictionsWatch March Madness games on FUBO (free trial)Purdue BoilermakersWith a last-second tip-in, Purdue advanced to the Elite Eight with a 79-77 win over No. 11 Texas on March 26.Purdue (30-8) is the No. 2 seed in the West Region.March Madness Elite 8 odds: Iowa vs Illinois | Purdue vs Arizona | Tennessee vs Michigan | UConn vs Duke | Betting odds | National championship oddsIowa HawkeyesIn a battle of two Big Ten teams, No. 9 Iowa prevailed over No. 4 Nebraska 77-71 to reach the Elite Eight.Nebraska led most of the game, and by as many as 10 points early. Iowa took its first lead with just over 2 minutes remaining to advance to the South Region final.How to watch Elite 8 games: Iowa vs Illinois | Purdue vs Arizona | Tennessee vs Michigan | UConn vs Duke | Schedule | Announcers | Who is in Elite 8?Watch NCAA Tournament games on Sling TVIllinois Fighting IlliniIllinois punched its ticket to the Elite Eight with a 65-55 victory over the No. 2 Houston Cougars in the Sweet 16.The Fighting Illini, the No. 3 seed in the South, limited the Cougars to 34% shooting from the field.Arizona WildcatsThe Wildcats are in the Elite Eight for the first time since 2015 after getting a 109-88 win over No. 4 Arkansas.Arizona, the No. 1 seed in the West, is now 35-2 on the season. it shot 64% from the field in the win.Duke Blue DevilsThe No. 1 seed in the East Region, the Blue Devils rallied in the second half to beat No. 5 seed St. John's to move to 35-2 on the season.Isaiah Evans had 25 points on 10-for-15 shooting in Duke's 80-75 win.Michigan WolverinesThe Wolverines, the No. 1 seed in the Midwest Region, pulled away from No. 4 Alabama in the second half in a 90-77 win, to move to 34-3 on the season.Michigan trailed at the half against the Crimson Tide, before dominating in the second half. Yaxel Lendeborg had 23 points on 8-for-12 shooting for Michigan, with 11 rebounds.UConn HuskiesThe Huskies, the East Region's No. 2 seed, held off No. 3 seed Michigan State in the Sweet 16, 67-63.UConn shot 9-for-21 from 3-point range and made some clutch baskets down the stretch to hang on for the win.Tennessee VolunteersThe No. 6 seed in the Midwest Region, Tennessee upset No. 2 seed Iowa State in the Sweet 16, 76-62.The Volunteers had a dominate night on the boards, outrebounding the Cyclones, 43-22, to be the final team to advance to the Elite Eight.When is the Elite Eight?The Elite Eight games will be played on Saturday, March 28, and Sunday, March 29, 2026.Saturday's March Madness schedule: Elite 8 games3:09 p.m.: No. 9 Iowa vs No. 3 Illinois, TBS/truTV (stream with Sling TV)5:49 p.m.: No. 2 Purdue vs No. 1 Arizona, TBS/truTV (stream with Sling TV)Sunday's March Madness schedule: Elite 8 games11:15 a.m.:No. 6 Tennessee vs No. 1 Michigan, CBS (stream with FUBO)2:05 p.m.: No. 2 UConn vs. No. 1 Duke, CBS (stream with FUBO)Watch March Madness games on Paramount+Reach Jeremy Cluff at jeremy.cluff@arizonarepublic.com.
